title: meta-omics/fetch_references parameters
description: Downloads, verifies (md5/sha256) and unpacks the reference data listed in a manifest into one reusable directory.

outdir.description: Reference directory. Used as storeDir: references already in <outdir>/<name>/ are not downloaded again.
outdir.help_text: Point it at shared storage to reuse the references across runs.

manifest.description: Tab-separated manifest with columns name, url, filename, md5, sha256, unpack, setup. Defaults to assets/references.tsv.
manifest.help_text: unpack: none or tar. setup: empty, or interproscan to run the release's setup.py after unpacking. Empty checksum cells may be written as '-'.

taxprofiler_sheet.description: Template of the nf-core/taxprofiler database sheet; '{refs}' is replaced by the absolute outdir. Defaults to assets/taxprofiler_databases.csv.

require_checksums.description: Refuse manifest rows that have neither md5 nor sha256.
require_checksums.help_text: Set to false once to bootstrap a new reference: its observed checksums are recorded in <outdir>/references.tsv and can then be copied into the manifest.
